en.description: Turn Xiaohongshu policy-question notes into one talking policy clip per still. This Xiaohongshu policy talking studio reads public policy-question notes, then records each already-written public-policy line as a 2 to 15s talking clip. Those policy talking clips stay separate files they can send on their own.
en.summary: Turn Xiaohongshu policy-question notes into one talking policy clip per still.
en.title: Xiaohongshu Policy Talking: Note Questions to Policy Clips
